fact: The Minister of Communication and Information Technology's 2026/27 budget speech of April 2026 says the Universal Communications Service Access Fund plans to take last-mile fibre connectivity to 10 councils (Halmashauri) in 2026/27, and that procurement of 100 video-conference sets for Local Government Authorities was under way and expected to finish by June 2026; it also says the national fibre backbone reached 13 more districts in 2025/26, making 122 of 139 districts connected by March 2026, which is the backbone's reach of districts and not a count of council offices connected.
title: Hotuba ya Waziri wa Mawasiliano na Teknolojia ya Habari Mheshimiwa Angellah Jasmine Mbelwa Kairuki (Mb.), akiwasilisha Bungeni Makadirio ya Mapato na Matumizi ya Fedha kwa Mwaka wa Fedha wa 2026/27
publisher: Wizara ya Mawasiliano na Teknolojia ya Habari
